title: 绯幕剧场

generationRuns.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. 为塔罗恶魔新主题「绯幕剧场」生成一张1024x1536竖版不透明完整母版。参考图仅用于两位成年人的身份、绘画质感及象征参考，重新设计完整构图。精细浪漫古典油画、细腻布料与自然肤色。酒红丝绒剧场，两位成年黑发男女全身左右相向，在中央轻持松垂可解的红绸半解蝴蝶结；红绸不是束缚，两双手自然可辨。恰好一只黑豹卧在下侧舞台，金杯葡萄放在侧桌，恰好两尊带角青铜静态雕像分列两侧，绝非活人或活羊。后方有明确敞开的出口与月夜。舞台地板完整延伸到下边出血，双人足底、豹卧区与桌腿接触地面。酒红、炭黑为主，细金点缀，窄细金丝绒边框无文字。所有脸手关键物件距画面边缘5%以上。不得新增人、动物、镜像人脸，禁止文字数字水印。仅完整RGB母版，不拆层，不绿幕，不透明棋盘。

Edit the supplied image. Output exactly one 1024x1536 image. Keep the original canvas coordinates and size of RETAINED objects only. Objects explicitly removed must be deleted completely; do not preserve their number. No redesign, no recentering, no frame except when frame is specifically requested. BACKGROUND PLATE ONLY. Delete ALL people, ALL animals, ALL main foreground props, ALL foreground support platforms/floors and their contact shadows, ALL floating foreground decoration, and the entire outer border/corner ornaments. NO people or animals may remain, including silhouettes and reflections. Reconstruct the distant environment naturally behind deleted objects. Keep only the distant landscape/architecture and original atmosphere. Do not add a second copy of the support ground. Opaque RGB image. Specific removed connected group: 双人、双手、红绸连接段整体；自由尾端不单独拉扯手，豹与地面同组；本主题支撑归属：舞台地板、豹卧区及两人足下同组. Environment ownership details: 除主体完整连接组、独立前景和固定框外的环境；必须补全清除区域，不保留重复主体或接触阴影。. Highest priority: an EMPTY clean environment, absolutely no protagonists or foreground props. Remove ALL decorative symbols attached to the margins, including the upper and lower crescents, attached stars, corner ornaments and rectangular border strokes. Fill those pixels with continuous natural environment textures. The result is a full-bleed clean background with absolutely NO card furniture. Image 1 is the edit target.
